notablePrerequisites:
Nardole has at least six counters on it.
Nardole does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Nardole by tapping it, adding at least six {U} that can only be spent to cast noncreature spells.
Cast Whispers of the Muse with buyback by paying {5}{U}.
Chakram Retriever triggers, untapping Nardole.
Resolve Whispers of the Muse, causing you to draw a card and return Whispers of the Muse to your hand.
Repeat.
If Nardole has at least seven counters on it, this combo nets near-infinite {U} that can only be spent to cast noncreature spells, and you may target any other creature using Chakram Retriever's trigger.
